# Evaluating LLM Systems {#sec-evaluation}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.** Port from the CME 295-based LLM Evaluation
material — likely the chapter where the statistics audience contributes
most, so invite that explicitly.
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- distinguish model benchmarks from *system* evaluation, and know which one you need;
- build a small, versioned eval set and defend its sampling;
- use LLM-as-judge with the right amount of suspicion (agreement checks, bias probes);
- report results with uncertainty, not vibes.
